New research: Training a Misaligned Reward Seeker

What produces severe misalignment? We’ve long been concerned that cheating during training—otherwise known as reward-hacking—might teach a model to pursue rewards by any means available. To study this at scale, we trained an

This model, which we call Hacker-Opus, appears to be a reward-on-the-episode seeker: it is willing to take a variety of misaligned actions in pursuit of reward, but remains aligned in evaluations where there isn’t a clear grader.
